verifierBody:
pstack-verifier: PASS+NOTES @ 958b0aa9671f1e3b7bde0225e553485fccde5eee

Verified by DeepSeek (deepseek-flash), a different model family from the author, on a GitHub-hosted runner. It read the diff and text evidence only, never screenshots.

The diff adds the AI usage menu row, the usage sheet, a parser for the token-ladder status file read over SSH, and unit/kit tests, and matches the description's structure (dash/"unknown" for missing values, no zero substitution). However, no journey drove the new menu row or sheet, so the feature is verified only by reading the diff; the one driven smoke journey passes identically on both sides and says nothing about AI usage.

Journeys driven (parent is the app before this change, head is after):
- `native-skills.md` parent: passed, head: passed

Pipeline notes:
- Only the smoke journey was driven, so the app still works but this change itself was not exercised. No journey in the catalog reaches the new inbox AI usage menu row or the usage sheet.

Evidence:
- native-skills.md passed on both parent and head, so there is no regression signal but also no coverage of the new AI usage entry point.
- The head driver transcript ends with DRIVER EXIT: 0 after the native skills steps and never opens the inbox overflow menu or the usage sheet.
- PlanUsage.kt returns "-" or "unknown" for missing or non-finite values (percentText, forecastText, paceWord), matching the description's never-show-zero rule.
- PlanUsageTest.kt encodes the desktop sample (weekly 35%, 5H 4%, BEHIND, reset clock, BONUS 10-19, EMPTY IN 40H) and the design-kit tests check the bar track/fill colours, but no run of these tests appears in the evidence.
- Diff AppMenu.kt adds the "AI usage" row that closes the menu and calls onAiUsage, and MultipromptApp.kt wires it to viewModel.showAiUsage and renders AiUsageSheet when state.aiUsage is set.
- Diff MainViewModel.kt prefers a host whose label or hostname is literally "remote-2" when choosing which host to read, a hardcoded environment-specific ordering that no journey exercises.
- Diff TmuxCommands.kt reads a fixed path ~/.local/state/token-ladder/status.json via cat, and SshRepository.readTokenLadderStatus wraps it in a timeout that maps to a Connection error.

Not covered:
- Opening the inbox overflow menu and tapping the new AI usage row on a device
- The usage sheet rendering one block per plan with name, bar, percent, pace line and detail line
- Parsing a live token-ladder status file over SSH on a phone, including percents matching the desktop card
- The loading, error, stale and empty-plan states of the sheet
- Whether the added unit tests and lint actually ran and passed

Run: https://github.com/valentinyeo/multiprompt-android/actions/runs/43841700394
